Another Century's Episode Portable.name: Another Century's Episode Portable
Another Century's Episode Portable.summary: Another Century's Episode Portable is a portable version of the Another Century's Episode series. The game combines elements of its four predecessors, with the gameplay being more reminiscent to the PlayStation 2 games. There is no plot; the game operates more like a mission simulator. Elements brought back include the old functional boost. The game also contains squad multiplayer.

Black Robinia.name: Black Robinia
Black Robinia.summary:
Based on the Drama CD series by Broccoli.

Who killed Blue Robin?

There is a mansion in the town where both of the protagonists (Rei & Akira) grew up in that is known as the Manor of Misfortune. On the day when Rei visits the place while hired as a private detective, a murder occurs. Then enters Akira, who now works as a police investigator, to lead to one of the worst reunions of old friends.

After basically avoiding each other for years after a certain incident, it’s time to slowly put away their sad past to focus on solving the case…

Rapala Trophies.name: Rapala Trophies
Rapala Trophies.summary:
Rapala Trophies is a fishing simulation for PSP where players set up fishing by piloting a boat to fishing spots, then cast and work the lure to attract fish. Hooking a catch involves reeling in while managing line tension and drag, with the game switching views during the fight so players can track how the fish responds.

The game emphasizes selecting tackle and fishing strategy to target different species across a variety of locations.

Saru! Get You! P!.name: Ape Escape: On the Loose
Saru! Get You! P!.summary: Based on the Ape Escape series, Ape Escape: On the Loose arrives on the PSP with multiplayer functionality and a variety of minigames. The new adventure begins when Specter--a monkey-turned-monster--and his army of monkeys travel back in time to change history and take over the world. Now it's up to you to pursue Specter and capture more than 200 monkeys in eight different worlds, which span more than 20 levels.

Soukoku no Kusabi - Hiiro no Kakera 3 Po.name: Soukoku no Kusabi Hiiro no Kakera 3 Portable
Soukoku no Kusabi - Hiiro no Kakera 3 Po.summary: A port of Soukoku no Kusabi Hiiro no Kakera 3 for PSP.

Ultraman All-Star Chronicle.name: Ultraman All-Star Chronicle
Ultraman All-Star Chronicle.summary: A Japan only PlayStation Portable strategy game developed by Bandai Namco Games as part of their long running Ultraman series
